Implementation Plan

Gaps established from code:
- **Why the repair didn't run on PR #9679:** the "CI failed on the updated head" comment comes from `review_freshness_ci_failed.sh`, which posts the `ai:freshness-ci-failed:v1` marker. The gate's repair decision only matches `ai:final-ci-failed:v1`, so it silently returned `no_final_ci_marker`.
- **What the judge sees:** its prompt never includes the CI snapshot the editor gets.
- **What happens on a red check:** a judge `merge` ends as `checks_failed`, which pages and does nothing else.

Plan follows.

## Implementation plan for #10063: send a red final CI to repair, not to a judge `merge`

Planning ref: `a5fba3f17620e886c167036fc4957975d1058531` (checkout ref `main`, symbolic branch `main`). `Integration branch mismatch: unknown`, not `true`, so it does not block.

### Automation (§20.E)
- **Scripts:** only existing code is extended. No new script, no supervisor, no DB work, no entry in `docs/scripts-pending-removal.md`.
- **Entry point:** the `codex-agent` job of `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml`:
  - the step "Review-blocked judge decision", which runs `scripts/review_rb_judge.sh`;
  - the gate job's evaluate step, which runs `scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh`.
- **Re-dispatch:** the judge starts a new review run with the existing `freshness_ci_failed_dispatch_review_workflow` helper in `scripts/review_freshness_ci_failed.sh`. `review_final_ci_failed.sh` already sources and uses it.

## Root cause (established in this planning step)

The issue asked the plan to trace why the #9663 repair did not run on PR #9679.

1. **The repair gate never matched.** The 08:46 comment text ("CI failed on the updated head … goes back to a normal review and autofix run") is the body that `scripts/review_freshness_ci_failed.sh` posts, around line 109. That script posts `<!-- ai:freshness-ci-failed:v1 pr= head= -->`. The gate's repair decision in `scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh` (about lines 1812–1945) builds `final_re` only from `ai:final-ci-failed:v1`. It therefore printed `decision=none reason=no_final_ci_marker`, and that reason is deliberately not logged, so the run left no trace.
2. **The judge got no CI data.** The editor reads `PR_CHECK_RUNS_CONTEXT_FILE` (embedded in `scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh` around line 1433). The judge prompt built in `scripts/review_rb_judge.sh` (sections "Collect PR context for judge" and "Build judge prompt") never reads that file. That is why the judge wrote "No logs were available".
3. **A red check on `merge` stops at a page.** In `review_rb_judge.sh`, `_pr_wait_for_required_checks` returning `failed` sets `RB_MERGE_STATUS=checks_failed` in two places: the `merge` branch (about line 2754) and the `fix` treated as merge at `IS_FINAL` (about line 2869). The alert step in `review_autofix.yml` (about line 5965) then sends "Needs a CI fix before the merge". Nothing repairs, and stall recovery fires the judge again on the same head.
4. **What already works and only needs a test:**
   - Exhausted budgets: the gate's decision reads neither `MAX_AUTOFIX_ITERATIONS` nor `MAX_REVIEW_BLOCKED_RETRIES`. The "Integration post-sync test repair" step's `if:` does not check `max_iterations_reached` either.
   - An `orchestrator/project-*` **base**: the gate and `review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh` (line 1113) only exclude an `orchestrator/project-*` **head**. PR #9679's head was a `claude/*` branch.
   - The head-gate on a freshness head: the freshness deterministic skip posts `ai-review/head-gate` success on that head (`review_head_gate_main`, `DETERMINISTIC_SKIP=true`).

## Functions or modules to implement

**A. `scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh`: the repair decision**
- Extend the inline Python decision so that `final_at` also counts these markers, trusted the same way as the existing marker (the `GATE_MARKER_AUTHOR_LOGIN` login, or `github-actions[bot]` with `author_type == Bot`):
  - `<!-- ai:freshness-ci-failed:v1 pr=<n> head=<head> -->`, which covers base-update heads;
  - a new `<!-- ai:final-ci-repair-request:v1 pr=<n> head=<head> -->`, posted by the judge (see C).
- A repair-request marker also stands in for the `ai-review/head-gate` success requirement, because the judge approved that exact head. Print it as a new token `approval=judge`. The shell `repair)` branch then skips the `commits/<head>/statuses` GET for that case, which saves one call.
- Keep the caps: `head_cap` (one attempt per head) and `pr_cap` (two repaired heads per PR).
- Add `marker=final|freshness|judge` to the end of the existing `FINAL_CI_REPAIR … outcome=selected` line. This only adds a field.
- Add both new marker strings to the `contains(...)` filter of `gate_fetch_marker_comments` (about line 366). Without that, they are clipped or dropped as activity-only comments.
- Add the repair-request marker to the same-head skip exceptions next to `final_ci_failed`:
  - the terminal same-head decision (about lines 544–609);
  - the clean same-head decision (about lines 732–805).
  
  This stops a dispatched run from being skipped as `terminal_same_head` or `clean_same_head`.

**B. `scripts/review_rb_judge.sh`: CI failure input for the judge**
- New function `render_review_rb_ci_failures_file <out>`. It fails open and writes an empty file on any error. Steps:
  1. Read `PR_CHECK_RUNS_CONTEXT_FILE`, which this job's "Collect PR check-run failures" step already wrote. Use it only if its `head_sha:` equals `RB_JUDGED_HEAD_SHA` and `failed_count > 0`. Otherwise write one line saying the snapshot is for another head, or is missing.
  2. For each `failed[i]`, take the job name and the run/job id from `details_url` (`/actions/runs/<id>/job/<jid>`).
  3. Make one `GET repos/<repo>/actions/runs/<id>/jobs?filter=latest&per_page=100` per distinct run id, for at most 3 run ids. Take each failed job's steps with `conclusion == failure`. Add the §14 audit comment: the snapshot has no step names and no existing judge call returns them.
  4. Get failing test ids by running `workflow_failure_heal.py heal-scope failing-tests --log-files <log_tail temp file>`, reusing the extractor `check_failure_triage.sh` uses. If that helper is not staged, show no test ids.
  5. Take the last error lines: up to 15 lines from the log tail ending at the last `##[error]` line, each cut to 300 characters.
  6. Limits: at most 10 jobs, 5 steps per job and 20 test ids per job. Test ids must match `^[A-Za-z0-9_./:\[\]-]{1,200}$`. Strip control characters.
- Embed the file in the prompt next to the other untrusted sections with `emit_review_rb_untrusted_file "CI FAILURES ON THE JUDGED HEAD" <file> 12000`.
- Write a one-line sanitised summary, for example `job/step: test1, test2; …` capped at 500 characters, to a step output `judge_ci_failure_summary` for the alert.

**C. `scripts/review_rb_judge.sh`: send a red check to repair instead of merging**
- Switch `RB_JUDGE_RED_CHECK_REPAIR_ENABLED`, default `true` in the script (§8). With `false`, today's behaviour is unchanged. The judge also honours `FINAL_CI_REPAIR_ENABLED`; when that is `false`, the red-check path goes straight to the hand-over.
- New function `rb_judge_route_red_checks`. It is called where `RB_MERGE_STATUS` becomes `checks_failed`, in both the `merge` branch and the `IS_FINAL` `fix`-as-merge branch.
  - **Caps.** Using the PR comments this script already reads (`PR_CONTEXT_JSON` / `PR_ISSUE_COMMENTS`, with no new read), count trusted `ai:final-ci-repair:v1` markers the same way the gate does: tried heads, plus repaired heads where `repair != none`.
  - **Eligible** (head not tried, fewer than 2 repaired):
    - post one comment ending in `<!-- ai:final-ci-repair-request:v1 pr=<n> head=<RB_JUDGED_HEAD_SHA> -->`, saying the merge was not executed and listing the failed jobs, steps and tests;
    - source `review_freshness_ci_failed.sh` and call `freshness_ci_failed_dispatch_review_workflow`;
    - set `RB_MERGE_STATUS=final_ci_repair_requested`.
  - **Capped**, or the switch is off:
    - post one hand-over comment ending in `<!-- ai:final-ci-handover:v1 pr=<n> head=<sha> -->`, listing the failures;
    - add `ai:needs-human` to the linked issues in `ISSUE_NUMBERS`;
    - set `RB_MERGE_STATUS=final_ci_handover`.
  - **Comments read incomplete** (`RB_JUDGE_COMMENTS_INCOMPLETE=true`): keep `checks_failed`. Failing toward a person is the safe direction.
  - Log `RB_JUDGE_RED_CHECK pr= head= outcome=repair_requested|handover|handover_already_posted|disabled|caps_unknown|dispatch_failed`.
- **Repeat guard before the LLM call** (the #9991-style dedupe). If a trusted `ai:final-ci-handover:v1` marker names the current live head, emit `judge_handled=true`, `judge_action=skip` and `judge_skip_reason=final_ci_handover_posted`, then exit 0: no comment, no alert, no judge run. A new head, for example a human push, clears the guard by itself.
- Decision values (`merge`, `fix`, `merge_with_followup`, `close_and_reissue`) and existing outputs and log
